name: Progression - Different Course, Different Provider, Subsequent AY (A Withdraws, B Completes)
description: Provider A (UKPRN 10005077) POSTs ZSC00001 for the learner, starting 2025-09-01 and withdrawn 2026-01-15 — entirely within AY 25/26. Employer approves it. In the following academic year, Provider B (UKPRN 10005078) POSTs a genuinely different course, ZSC00002, starting 2026-09-01 and completing 2027-02-15 (AY 26/27), via the new-style route with academicYear=2627 explicitly appended. Employer approves Provider B's course too. Provider B then PUTs again, nudging the completionDate a few days later (2027-02-15 → 2027-02-20), to check that a post-approval completion-date adjustment on the second, cross-AY, different-provider episode is applied cleanly. Not a Change-of-Provider scenario — CoP is same course code, different provider; this is a different course code and a different provider, i.e. a cross-AY variant of `progression-different-course-b-approved`. GetByLearnerKeyAndCourseCode should create a second, independent Learning for Provider B's course code, and the AY-scoped omission-removal predicate (FLP-1875/FLP-1895) should not touch Provider A's already-withdrawn AY 25/26 episode when Provider B's AY 26/27 POST lands. Expects 2 ShortCourseEpisode rows (one per provider) in both Learning and Earnings DBs, and Provider B's completion date updated to 2027-02-20.

steps.name: SLD (Provider A) Creates Short Course ZSC00001, Starts Sep 2025, Withdrawn Jan 2026 (AY 25/26)
Employer Approves Provider A's Short Course
SLD (Provider B) Creates a Different Short Course, ZSC00002, Starting Sep 2026 and Completing Feb 2027 (AY 26/27) — new-style URI with academicYear=2627
Employer Approves Provider B's Short Course
Get Learner Key (from Provider B's ZSC00002 episode)
SLD (Provider B) PUTs ZSC00002 Again, Completion Date Adjusted from 2027-02-15 to 2027-02-20

assertions.name: 2 ShortCourseEpisode rows in Learning DB (one per provider, Provider A's not removed by omission)
2 ShortCourseEpisode rows in Earnings DB across both providers
Provider B's ZSC00002 completion date updated to 2027-02-20 in Learning DB, StartDate unchanged
Provider B's ZSC00002 completion date updated to 2027-02-20 in Earnings DB
